purpose: Distinguish a weak 3-session reversal clue from feature redundancy and a linear-model expression limitation.
trigger: Initial 3-session reversal difference is positive in 3/4 years but its 95% interval crosses zero; other expansions have no stable increment.
adaptive_design_disclosure: This design is chosen after seeing initial component results. Same development-pool outcomes are reused; it is not independent validation.
ablation: At horizon 3 only, add each of four reversal features separately to the baseline and remove each separately from the full reversal group. Fixed ridge penalty remains 10.
expression_control: At all four horizons, repeat baseline and the three augmented families with one fixed depth-2 regression tree, minimum leaf size 50, seed 13. No depth or leaf-size tuning.
causality: Reuse original eligible dates, mature-label purge, train-only preprocessing and training prediction quantile thresholds.
uncertainty: 5000 within-year paired circular 20-session block draws; report ordinary 95% and Bonferroni 1-0.05/32 intervals for these followups. Adaptive design still limits inference.
scope: No account strategies, hyperparameter search, new external inputs, economic gates or stage-three advancement.
